name: University of Neuchâtel
description: The University of Neuchâtel (UniNE) is a public French-speaking university founded as an academy in 1838 and a university since 1909. It has four faculties: humanities and social sciences, science, law, and economics and business.
whyIncluded: The University of Neuchâtel is among the 10 universities in Switzerland most chosen by international students (about 23% of its 4,365 students are international, per Times Higher Education World University Rankings data), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own monthly budget for a student renting a room, using the middle of its ranges, for 12 months a year. Excludes fees, health insurance and taxes.
livingCosts.notes: UniNE 'Managing your finances' page (monthly, ranges; midpoints used): housing = rent incl. bills 370-700 (535) + cleaning 20-40 (30) = 565; food = meals (canteen) 400-500 (450); transport = travel 10-220 (115); personal = clothes 70-100 (85) + hairdresser/hygiene 30-50 (40) + pocket money/phone 150-200 (175) + doctor/dentist/optician 60 = 360. Excluded: registration/tuition/materials 200-400, sickness/accident insurance 350-380, taxes/AHV 40-80. UniNE total for independent students CHF 1,700-2,780. Page undated, read 2026-10-07.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Economics and Business
programmes.summary: Yearly course fee for foreign students whose parents live abroad, plus fixed and exam fees. A one-off CHF 100 fee applies to applicants with foreign qualifications.
programmes.notes: Neuchatel cantonal Arrete concernant le montant de la finance d'inscription percue par l'Universite de Neuchatel (18 Feb 2004, status 1 March 2024), published by UniNE: art. 3 course and laboratory fees per year CHF 1,400 for students of foreign nationality whose parents live abroad (CHF 850 for Swiss); art. 2 fixed fees CHF 120 a year; art. 5 exam fees CHF 30 a year; compulsory = 150. Art. 5bis (since 1 Aug 2014): CHF 100 processing fee for applicants with a foreign entrance qualification. The optional FEN student federation fee (CHF 15 a semester) is excluded. Fee history: the amounts have been unchanged since 2004 (later amendments only renamed the department and added art. 5bis in 2014), and the version in force from 1 March 2024 covers 2024-25 and 2025-26, so those rows use the same figures. 3-year (180 ECTS) Faculty of Economics and Business bachelor, taught mainly in French.
